verdict.rationale: Claude has a dedicated Voice mode enabling complete spoken conversations, available across mobile, desktop, and web, but it is explicitly labeled beta, works best on phone (implying limitations elsewhere), and no independent/hands-on evidence corroborates real-time naturalness or latency quality. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of conversational latency and naturalness, detail on interruption/turn-taking handling, and confirmation the feature is out of beta.
